title: EV campaign APR from the dealer bank
description: The dealer bank finances EVs at 3.99% APR from 1 November. Adds `apr_percent_by_segment` to config/leasing.php and lets RateCalculator use a segment's APR when one is configured, falling back to apr_percent. The constructor argument is optional, so existing callers are unchanged.

defects.explanation: This changes every EV quote and stored EV rate, but there is no test for it and no entry in approved-changes.json with the pricing owner's sign-off, so the golden master will fail or be re-recorded.
